regime_read: The clearest measured convergence is in semiconductors, government-linked software, pharma catalysts, and an activist airline situation, but the signals remain unusual activity rather than proven edge. With no completed track-record observations, conviction stays modest despite several six-channel clusters.
regime_read_zh: 目前最清晰的多源信号集中在半导体、政府相关软件、医药催化剂和航空公司维权事件，但这些信号仅代表异常活动，并非已证明的超额收益来源。由于尚无已完成评估的历史判断，即使部分标的达到六通道汇聚，置信度仍保持克制。

theses.thesis: MU has the pack's strongest actionable alignment: purchases by four members of Congress, strongly positive measured insider activity, accelerating federal grants, and a large patent cluster coincide with bullish retail sentiment and a disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]. Its 60-day relative underperformance and non-extended flag leave room for the signals to translate without chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现证据包中最强的可操作汇聚：四名国会议员的净买入、明显为正的内部人士活动、加速的联邦拨款和较大的专利集群，与看涨的散户情绪及已披露的Ro Khanna关联同时出现 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Ro Khanna]。其60日相对表现落后且未被标记为过度延伸，为信号转化留下了空间。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand, while AMAT also has congressional and patent signals in the pack
Semiconductor equipment — any sustained memory expansion would pull through fabrication-tool spending
Data-center memory supply chain — stronger memory demand would benefit upstream materials and component suppliers
theses.dissent: MU has underperformed SPY by 13.9 percentage points over 60 days, which may reflect deteriorating memory fundamentals that transactional and sentiment signals have not captured.

falsifier.text: Federal-grant momentum reverses and insider activity turns net negative while MU continues losing relative ground to SPY.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: PLTR combines recent government-contract activity and acceleration with a uniformly bullish analyst cluster, strong retail attention, bullish Stocktwits sentiment, and disclosed links to Cathie Wood and Marjorie Taylor Greene [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Cathie Wood] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]. The signal is mixed because the pack's Trump-linked indicator is explicitly on the sell side, and the stock has already outperformed SPY materially, so the appropriate posture is watch rather than chase.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR同时具备近期政府合同活动及其加速、集中看涨的分析师信号、较高的散户关注度、Stocktwits看涨情绪，以及与Cathie Wood和Marjorie Taylor Greene的已披露联系 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Cathie Wood] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]。但证据并不完全一致：证据包中的特朗普相关指标明确位于卖出侧，而且该股已显著跑赢SPY，因此更适合观察而非追涨。
second_order: MSFT — enterprise and government AI adoption can support adjacent cloud-compute demand
Government IT modernization — durable contract activity would benefit integrators and secure-cloud vendors
Defense analytics software — PLTR contract momentum would indicate broader agency spending on data platforms
theses.dissent: The Trump-linked sell signal conflicts with the bullish cluster, while strong retail enthusiasm and 60-day relative outperformance increase crowding and entry risk.

falsifier.text: Government-contract acceleration turns negative and subsequent contract activity fails to sustain the recent pace.

theses.thesis: MRK's read rests on eleven Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, substantial lobbying activity, and a Trump-linked buy indicator [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]. Proposed cancer-care planning legislation supplies a broad healthcare-policy backdrop, but it is only introduced and does not establish a direct MRK benefit [bill:HR10087]. With relative performance already strong and four clinical halts in the pack, the catalyst set merits monitoring rather than immediate accumulation.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK的判断基于11项三期临床启动、FDA标签扩展信号、较大的游说活动以及特朗普相关买入指标 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]。拟议中的癌症照护规划法案提供了广义医疗政策背景，但该法案仅处于提出阶段，且不能证明MRK会直接受益 [bill:HR10087]。考虑到相对表现已经较强，且证据包记录了4项临床暂停，更适合持续观察催化剂而非立即介入。
second_order: Oncology diagnostics — broader cancer-care planning could increase testing and treatment-pathway coordination
Clinical-research services — a large late-stage pipeline supports demand for trial execution and monitoring
Healthcare providers — proposed Medicare cancer-care coordination payments could support oncology service infrastructure
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts create a meaningful counter-signal, and the proposed healthcare legislation is preliminary rather than a company-specific catalyst.

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts outweigh new Phase 3 starts and the expected label expansion does not progress.

theses.thesis: LUV presents a coherent event-driven setup: an activist 13D, disclosed Paul Singer affiliation, strong measured app engagement, and multiple recent material 8-K filings point to simultaneous governance, customer-demand, and corporate-change activity [activist_13d] [actor:Paul Singer] [app_demand] [material_8k]. The stock is non-extended and has lagged SPY modestly, so the entry is not being chased, although the pack provides no direct operating or margin evidence.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV呈现较连贯的事件驱动组合：维权投资者13D申报、已披露的Paul Singer关联、较强的应用端参与度，以及近期多份重大8-K文件，共同指向治理、客户需求和公司变革活动 [activist_13d] [actor:Paul Singer] [app_demand] [material_8k]。该股未被标记为过度延伸，且近期小幅落后SPY，因此并非追涨；不过证据包没有提供直接的经营或利润率证据。
second_order: Airline technology vendors — operational restructuring could increase spending on scheduling and revenue-management systems
Aircraft maintenance suppliers — improved fleet utilization or refurbishment would support aftermarket demand
Domestic travel ecosystem — sustained app engagement would support airports, lodging, and travel-service providers
theses.dissent: App ratings and filings do not establish improving unit economics, and activist involvement can produce disruption without operational gains.

falsifier.text: Activist-led changes fail to produce measurable operating improvement while app engagement weakens.
